name: gradio
notes: typescript+python: gradio v5.7.0. python backend (gradio/) plus svelte+ts frontend (js/). exercises atlas's python intra-file extractor and ts cross-package resolution side-by-side; also a real cross-language API (python emits openapi consumed by ts client) so the api_endpoints surface should detect cross-stack handlers if/when py cross-file resolution lands.
